title: qa/v1
description: targets/<id>/qa/<subject>-<n>.yaml (F12-R1, R2, R15; D-9 v3.12): one run of the statement-QA pass over one subject — the root statement, or one definition in defs/ — pinned to the statement hash it ran on and the toolchain and Mathlib it ran under. Append-only: one file per run, never edited; a record whose statement hash or pins no longer match the subject is stale and counts for nothing (R5). Every check is exactly one of two kinds: an `exhibit` row is a kernel fact (a screen's outcome, a compile, a proved equivalence) and is the only kind that may be cited as evidence for a fidelity grade; a `brief` row is a judgement (a review brief, a back-translation) and raises no grade on its own (R2). An exhibit row that names a file carries its SHA-256, and the file is trusted by content, never by path (R15, C9). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

subject.description: `root`, or the name of a definition in the target's defs/ (the same subjects as fidelity/v1).

statement_hash.description: The subject's content hash when the run happened: the root's statement hash, or the SHA-256 of the definition file. A record for any other hash is stale (R5).

mathlib_sha.description: The graph's Mathlib pin when the run happened; a record under another pin is stale (R5: junk-value defects move with the library).

produced_by.description: The command that wrote the record, e.g. `opn-gate qa screen`.

kind.description: D-9 v3.12: layers 1, 2 and 4 emit exhibits; layer 3 emits a judgement.

model.description: The model that ran, where one did (brief, backtranslation); null otherwise.

verdict.description: For a screen: `pass` means the screen found nothing, `fail` means it proved its target and the exhibit is the finding. `inconclusive` is a timeout, an exhausted budget, a toolchain or model error — never a clean pass (C7).

exhibit.description: The path, relative to the graph root, of the file this row rests on — a kernel-checked exhibit for kind `exhibit`, the brief or back-translation text for kind `brief` — or null when the row produced no file (a clean screen, a compile).

exhibit_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file `exhibit` names; required whenever `exhibit` is a path (R15).

elapsed_s.description: Wall-clock seconds the check took, for the budget record (F12 §6, Q4).

budget_s.description: The tactic budget the attempt ran under, where one applied.

note.description: Free text about the row: the diagnostic behind an inconclusive verdict, the consequence lemma a screen tried, the pair an equivalence compared. Untrusted downstream (F12 §7).
